findings.address_as_written: the north side of Ellis Street between Powell and Mason (now the Hotel Fusion)
findings.description: Jonathan Kittredge, owner of the Phoenix Iron Works, built a two-and-a-half-storey gabled Carpenter Gothic house on the north side of Ellis Street between Powell and Mason for his Christmas Eve marriage. The homestead included an artesian well, a small backyard orchard and a cow.

citation.label: Peter M. Field, “A Tenderloin District History: The Pioneers of St. Ann's Valley: 1847–1860,” The Argonaut: Journal of the San Francisco Historical Society, vol. 30, no. 2 (Winter 2020), pp. 42–83
